description: Generate original band names by genre — rock, metal, pop, hip-hop, electronic, jazz, punk or indie — with one click and copy.

faqs.a: Each genre has its own curated word pools, and the generator combines them in genre-typical patterns (e.g. The + plural for rock, dark compounds for metal).
They are original random combinations from word lists — always do a trademark search before using one commercially.
faqs.q: Can I use a name for my real band?

faqs.a: Press Generate again for a fresh batch of 8 names.
Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Click any name to copy it.
title: Band Name Generator
